subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The teacher asked the students to _______ attention towards the instructions given for the project.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**pay**" is commonly used with the noun **"attention"** to form the phrase "**pay attention**."
 
• The sentence is instructing students to focus on the instructions given, which fits the usage of "**pay attention**."
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and **3** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is ***"The teacher asked the students to pay__ attention towards the instructions given for the project."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "make"** is incorrect because we do not "make" attention.
 
• **Option 2: "had"** is incorrect because it does not fit the sentence structure appropriately.
 
• **Option 3: "keen"** is incorrect as "keen attention" is not a standard phrase and does not fit grammatically.
